name: fast-project-start
body:
`apg project start` must be near-instant when the new worktree's commit has already been scanned. Today a fresh worktree at an already-scanned commit is not a full scan (`rust.apg.delta.full_scan_reason` returns None) but the delta target set is empty, so `rust.apg.should_spawn_language(false, true, false)` returns true and `rust.apg.cmd_scan` runs every frontend unfiltered (needed only because module scaffolding is not per-file). Once identity is portable, start should seed the branch DB by copy/rebased reuse (`rust.apg.splice`, `rust.apg.cache.rebase`) with zero frontend spawns.

Acceptance criteria:
- Starting a project at a commit already present in the shared cache spawns no frontend process.
- The resulting branch DB contains the same code nodes and edges as a full scan of that commit.
- The seeding completes without a full-tree walk of the source files.
- Correctness is preserved when the recorded scan came from a different checkout/worktree (rebased reuse).
